The largest bone in the human body is the femur (thigh bone).

Regarding the physical therapy technique described in the evidence, Myofascial Release (MFR) is generally considered effective for treating myofascial pain syndrome. By applying gentle, sustained pressure to the fascial connective tissues, MFR aims to release restrictions that limit motion and cause pain. This technique can help relieve pain and increase the range of motion by targeting sensitive trigger points within the muscles. However, its effectiveness can vary depending on the individual and the specific nature of the injury or condition being treated.
